itinerary.title: Fansipan - Hanoi
activities: Train to Cable Car Fansipan Mountain (included)
Cable Car to Fansipan Mountain (world's longest and highest cable car)
Cat Cat Village (H'mong ethnic mountain village)

itinerary.title: Hanoi
activities: Dong Xuan Market (the largest fashion market)
Hanoi Old City (exploring the local culture and souvenir shopping)
Hoan Kiem Lake (natural fresh water lake, called the sword lake)

expect.title: Long Journey
expect.body: Hanoi to Sapa one way normally takes around 6 to 8 hours depending on traffic.

expect.title: Prepare for Weather
expect.body: Rainy May - October. Sunny November - April.

expect.title: Lots of Walking
expect.body: Some attractions require a lot of walking.

expect.title: Full Board Meals
expect.body: Meals are already included in the package. If you choose not to consume them, no refund will be provided.

expect.title: Hotel Locations
expect.body: Normally outside the city centre, but the driving guide is committed to drive around the city centre if requested.

expect.title: Luggage Allocation
expect.body: Please bring a maximum of 1 luggage per pax, as it affects car capacity.
